_about: H9 the boing, with the drop machine (D15g, decision 27; js/clinic/heal/games/boing.js). The doctor holds the syringe; the child helps and counts. Wipe the arm the count of times; pull a dispenser's lever for each drop of liquid medicine that falls into the upright syringe (counted on the syringe; a drop is taken back by tapping that drop); press the syringe's glowing end to start the jab; the doctor counts down, BOING; a plaster on the spot. The apple is only at the send-off (H33, CLN-66). Level 1: one dispenser, the count written and said (closes at the count); level 2: more drops, written only, closed by the glowing end; level 3: three or four dispensers and the colours said in order (pela/ne poi). Blind level 1: 1/5 (wipes) x 1/3 (drops). The numbers and pela/ne poi are Cook's; wipe, drops, plaster, press it and the colours are English placeholders to record.

jab.name: the jab before the village trip

1.note: One dispenser. Wipe, the drops (the count written and said; the row turns gold at the count and the step closes by itself), then the glowing end, the countdown from trae, BOING, the plaster.

2.note: + more drops, the count written only; the glowing end closes the drops step (D7: the next action).

3.note: + four dispensers and the colours said, in order: ba [red], ne poi hakro [blue]; the card is closed (heard only).

camera._about: D2 (1 Oct): the wide shot the zoom starts from, chosen by the angle the close-up needs (front-on or side-on). No side-on sitting pose exists yet: 'side' uses the front pose until the art batch (art list A1).
camera._target: A1 (5 Oct): the match cut. target = where the close-up draws the sore part and size = its radius, in the close-up's 800 x 500 units: the push-in ends with the patient's part (from the art's anchor) at that place and size.

art._about: The art plan's D1 and D2 (docs/design-language/art-plans/clinic-heal-art-plan.md §8), swapped in by file name when they exist; until then the code-drawn machine, levers, drops and syringe. The levers, drops and the two-layer syringe need their cut positions (tube, socket, spout) before they replace the drawn ones.
